name: Critical Bad End3 -spiral of despair-
source:
Fallen to Deathspire, the path of total collapse.
The angels were scattered to protect humanity.
But they each fell helplessly to the prelude.

All angels meet a bad ending. Hope is lost.
From here it's a downward spiral.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071893.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
坠入死亡之塔，彻底崩溃的道路。
天使们为了保护人类而分散开来。
但他们却各自无奈地跌入了序幕。

所有的天使都会有一个糟糕的结局。希望落空了。
从这里开始，这是一个螺旋式下降。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
